candidate_evidence.quote: N-803 (other names: ALT-803, Anktiva): Participants will receive 1mg subcutaneously (SC) on Day 1 and Day 15 of each repeated cycle of treatment.
The phase 2 portion is an open-label, single-arm study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of NAI, PD-L1 t-haNK, and bevacizumab combination therapy in participants with recurrent or progressive GBM.

coder_notes: N-803 INN taken from the official title (nogapendekin alfa inbakicept). PD-L1 t-haNK is an NK cell therapy (excluded type) although registered as Drug. Bevacizumab given in every arm -> soc_backbone; TTFields device in phase 2B arms. Phase 2B Arm A (without t-haNK) serves as a comparator for the t-haNK question, but both arms are experimental regimens with N-803, not SOC/placebo, so control_arm_from_other_arms coded no. PK and ADA are serum only; cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-6) are safety measures. IDH-wildtype stated for phase 2B (diagnostic, not candidate-matched); phase 2 cites WHO CNS5.
